title: Prune stale lead memory and move lessons into checks
body:
Outcome: no auto-memory note cites retired lead.sh/pdeliver or a missing path (a reference checker prints 0); lesson-type notes become checks or AGENTS rules per D14 (with t-3ha9z96, t-e2k99h7); MEMORY.md lists only current facts.
Evidence: .krn/runs/program-audit/synthesis.md (operator grant ./grant.md, 2026-11-01).
